race.comment: BLENHEIM GIRL (2) scored a comfortable win first up in town over the 1200m, then found a strong BM72 with a below-par eighth to Avista over 1400m at Randwick. Has the talent to finish over the top of these. FIRE 'N' STONE (12) drops in weight third up and ready to deliver from the good barrier. Shouldered the 60kg for a game fourth over 1400m at Gunnedah. Fitter now and will be tough to beat. BEVERLY HILLS (9) has struggled in her two runs back and deserves another chance out to the 1350m. Finished a narrow third to The Mona Lisa last November, and not without each-way claims. DIVINE SECRETS (3) consistent mare who closed off well first up with a tidy second over 1250m at Newcastle. Can get cover from the draw and sure to be thereabouts.
